related_questions.question: Why is the IRS sending me a notice?
related_questions.snippet: The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) will send a notice or a letter for any number of reasons. It may be about a specific issue on your federal tax return or account, or may tell you about changes to your account, ask you for more information, or request a payment.

related_questions.question: What happens after the IRS notice of deficiency 2021?
related_questions.snippet: After you get the Statutory Notice of Deficiency, you'll have 90 days to petition the U.S. Tax Court before paying the taxes, if you disagree with the IRS. You won't get any extensions of time past the 90-day deadline, so it's important to act quickly.
